text:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT (SEV2) - us-west-2 hosted inference nodes showing rising 5xx for streaming endpoints; initial impact ~3% of requests. Investigating.

mike (oncall): taking this, paging runtime and infra. seeing pod restarts on stream-pool-3. grabbing logs.

anya (runtime): any recent changes to eviction policy? we merged a change to disable hard caps on kv-cache during low CPU windows last night.

kevin (infra): logs from pod-7: ```
E0601 07:12:03 runtime.go:512] kv-cache: live=312k, mem=2.6Gi, eviction_disabled=true
OOMKilled
```

mike (oncall): confirmed regression window ~07:10 UTC after config rollout. rolling a config revert to re-enable hard cap and trigger eviction.

olivia (support): informing impacted customers and posting status link.

status-bot: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/202345 - "Investigating elevated errors in us-west-2 streaming. Mitigation in progress."

anya (runtime): initiating staged restart with eviction-enabled config; canary first. monitoring 5xx and mem usage.

kevin (infra): canary shows mem drop from 2.6Gi -> 230Mi and 5xx on canary reduced 4.1% -> 0.2%. proceeding staged rollout.

mike (oncall): rollout in progress 20% -> 50% -> 100%, 2m observe windows. fallback: route heavy streaming traffic to alternative region if needed.

olivia (support): customers reporting recovery; one enterprise asked for postmortem. logging request.

anya (runtime): patch queued for eviction safety-net: hard mem cap + periodic compaction. will follow up with PR and tests.

sre-bot: Incident update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/202345 - Partial mitigation observed; verification ongoing.

mike (oncall): RESOLVED at 2026-06-01T07:24:04Z. streaming 5xx back to baseline. Creating RCA and action items. :white_check_mark:
